title: Auditable entity
description: A domain-neutral foundational pattern: any concept tagged with the 'auditable' trait must have an identity, a lifecycle that governs its states, and at least one state-changing action. Referenced by trait only, so it applies to any domain.

roles.title: Auditable entity
roles.description: An entity whose state changes must be governed and traceable.

obligations.title: Auditable entities are changed by an explicit action
